name: Pressmaster.ai
description:
Pressmaster connects Claude to your content workspace. Train a Digital Twin on your expertise through interviews and your own documents, then write social posts, articles, newsletters, and video scripts that sound like you rather than like a model.

Every draft runs against your Brand Guide and saved Brand Voices, so tone and avoid-rules carry across formats. Publish to your connected social accounts right away or schedule a date and time. Articles and newsletters work the same way.

You can also start a content interview on any topic to get material back, save and search ideas, move items through your Content Library, and pull reach, impressions, engagement, and top posts for any date range.

For founders, executives, and B2B teams who publish regularly and want it all in one place.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pressmaster.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pressmaster.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.pressmaster.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pressmaster.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pressmaster.ai lists 46 MCP tools, including analytics_get_general_analytics, analytics_get_social_stats, analytics_get_sync_status, analytics_get_top_posts, brand_create_voice, brand_get_guide, brand_get_voice, brand_list_voices, brand_update_voice, content_library_attach_post_channels, content_library_attach_post_media, and content_library_create.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pressmaster.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Pressmaster.ai in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Pressmaster.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pressmaster.ai is developed by Pressmaster.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
